newsitem.title: UK: Brent jumps as June 4-6 cargo fetches July -10 cts.
newsitem.headline: Brent jumps as June 4-6 cargo fetches July -10 cts.

text.p: Dated Brent jumped 10 cents in late trade on Tuesday as a U.S. refiner picked up another cargo for a VLCC sailing transatlantic in early June, traders said.
The refiner paid July Brent -10 cents for a cargo loading June 4-6 which was earlier kept from the paper chains by British Petroleum.
The same buyer paid July Brent -20 cents for a June 3-5 cargo on Monday.
Earlier, two cargoes due to load May 27-29 were sold at July Brent -25 cents by a Wall Street trader to a French refiner.
